prompts.title: 01 · 粗线平涂
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL 2D character art-direction sample board for a mature wasteland survival card game named The End. This is an early design comparison, not a screenshot or mockup. Completely redesigned characters, simple economical drawing, highly readable silhouettes, animation-friendly separated body shapes, a restrained dusty earth palette. Three full-body characters side by side, standing on one baseline with generous negative space: left a scrappy adult human survivor in a hooded short poncho, square scavenger backpack, cloth wraps and work boots; center a lanky infected scavenger with long drooping arms, torn worker clothing and an unsettling simple face; right a broad heavy infected industrial worker with an old welding mask, oversized work jacket, crude salvaged shoulder plate and heavy boots. A dry, dangerous atmosphere with restrained personality. Different widths and poses must distinguish all three at thumbnail size. Simple faces and only a few purposeful worn marks. No gore, no exposed organs. The human is facing slightly right, the two enemies slightly left. Keep every silhouette uncropped. Bottom narrow strip: four small consecutive poses of the same human, idle, anticipation, forward strike, recovery, demonstrating how this design can be animated; each figure consistent and spaced. Clean plain warm off-white background. No scenery, game UI, rendered cards, photorealism, 3D, pixel-art, intricate textile details, dense shading, logos or watermarks. Small clean uppercase labels SURVIVOR, WANDERER, BRUTE under main characters. Landscape art board. ART DIRECTION 01 — BOLD FLAT INK. Thick confident dark-brown clean outlines, chunky simple volumes, approximately 3.5-head adult cartoon proportions, tiny expressive eyes, ONE large shadow shape per body part, flat matte ochre, rust orange and olive fills, very minimal surface detail. Graphic and slightly rough rather than cute. Visually closest to a clean hand-drawn indie game asset system. The drawings must feel very simple and easy to animate, not a detailed comic book. Heading at top left: 01 / BOLD FLAT INK.
